body.interpretation: Finite exposed-fact acquisition is admitted; learned retrieval, semantic relevance and lifecycle integration require their own gates.

protocol.budget: One local run at a time. Development and confirmation share600 host seconds; each training arm has at most60. Check deadlines between bounded trials; bounded initial/final evaluation follows and is charged separately. No cloud campaign. Solver counters and host seconds are not physical energy.
protocol.controls: Matched every-row teaching in development, frozen initial checkpoint for each life, and a separately seeded uniform-random policy. Report final acquired checkpoints, never best-of-training readings. No production defaults change.
protocol.custody: Evaluate from saved forks and check the acquired checkpoint is unchanged. Keep complete source/protocol/schedule hashes, actual decisions, all attempted teacher/answer work, refused cases and checkpoint content digests. Preserve the earlier attention and relevance protocols/failed receipts byte-for-byte.
protocol.data: Reuse selective_recall.CASES and inputs(exposed=True): both unselected facts, both queries, both orders, all sixteen cases each round. Same SeedSequence([31014, founder]) permutations for both teaching policies. Transient state resets between trials; the same parameters persist. All cases are trained, so no novel binding or semantic-code claim.
protocol.gate: Training must complete and both intact and trace-erased evaluation must complete without answer refusals. Intact overall, unequal-fact and EACH query accuracy must reach the unchanged 0.95 floor. Every refused/unrun case remains in the denominator. All20 confirmation founders must pass; positive mean improvement over their frozen initial checkpoints is reported separately.

recipes.name: normalized-qualified
recipes.reason: Keep the failed longer-budget point fixed; compare teaching all rows versus wrong rows from the complete pre-query drive. Both arms act before teaching. This isolates the existing mismatch gate without a gradient, architecture or solver change.

recipes.name: historical-founder
recipes.reason: Only if the first recipe fails development: restore the existing acquisition_controls.py surprise recipe and its historical two-action operating point. Finite teaching is explicit, with free1024/nudged12; zero refusals do not certify teaching residuals. Explicit -0.5 is a historical control, not a default proposal.

protocol.scope: Exposed-fact acquisition/content-use control, not learned memory selection or an integrated life.
protocol.selection: Compare every and wrong on both development founders, with identical initial checkpoints/settings. Prefer normalized-qualified if BOTH wrong-policy founders pass. Run historical-founder only if it fails. Choose no later recipe after the first passing one. Confirmation runs the chosen wrong policy only; fresh founder seeds are not new fact combinations. No tuning after opening confirmation.
protocol.teaching: The existing acquisition_controls.py corrected schedule: capture every stream's complete stimulus BEFORE the query act, act greedily, then teach every row (control) or only incorrectly answered rows (candidate) from those saved drive rows. No post-update query act. No-wrong rounds teach nothing. Teacher labels only the current query; no fabricated rewards, slot addresses or relevance masks.

body.source_identity: The manifest binds imported code and protocol, including uncommitted bytes.
